status: Unreviewed AI drafts; no fluent-speaker approval. Whole-app goal remains incomplete.
scope: 71 source variants: typed metric/chart text, figure chrome, calendar alternatives and fictional-garden chart descriptions. The figure drawing annotations and concept-art content are still outstanding.
isolatedFixture: The real overview/card components were rendered with their actual CSS, existing demo facts and a fictional garden. Calendar and long-label SVGs used the production renderer. Forty SVG cases had no text outside their viewBoxes; every image decoded. Thirty-two screenshots were captured; the sixteen inspected calendar/progress/water screenshots are committed. No claim that a static SSR fixture exercised React scroll-cue effects.
appFixture: Owned browser profile; English QA saved report with existing demo facts. At a glance selected, charts enlarged locally and Escape used to close. Next-generation language stayed English. No paid request or PDF creation was made. All sixteen actual-app screenshots were inspected and committed. Original saved bytes and body stayed exact; no horizontal overflow.
